title: Kuro made with your original 3D workflow (ChatGPT chibi, then Meshy)
question: The first sheets are pictures (the chibi picture steps), the rest are renders of a real rigged 3D model; open the live 3D link to turn her and watch her idle and walk beside the in-game Eric and Mio. Does Kuro fit next to them, and should the other characters go through the same steps?

options.label: kuro-1
options.note: The rigged model from d-412: smart topology, 1,078 triangles, textured in a second pass, auto-rigged at 1.1 m. 20 credits in all. Her head is smaller against her body than Eric's and Mio's, and her eyes are teal-green where the portrait's are grey. No glasses, no hair sticks.

links.label: Live 3D: Kuro beside the in-game Eric and Mio (turn, zoom, idle, walk) (only on the local bible)
Eric and Mio in the game's character viewer (Kuro isn't there; she's not in the game)

decision: Bad; redo with his exact process via ChatGPT's image model (kuro-meshy-orig-2)
